scripts.radio:
Jambo citizens, welcome to Kenya on Record. This week, we are looking closely at the referee of our democracy—the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission.

Talks surrounding the IEBC hit a stalemate after opposition leaders walked out, citing procedural unfairness and partisan bias in how the negotiations were being steered. Now, regardless of your political alignment, an electoral commission that cannot command trust across the board is a serious red flag for the nation. 

When key stakeholders walk out over disputed procedures, it signals a dangerous breakdown in consensus. History has taught us that a referee perceived to be biased long before an election creates instability long before voters even cast a single ballot. The selection, structure, and operational rules of the electoral body are not just elite political games—they directly dictate whether your vote will count in a peaceful, credible election. We cannot afford shortcut processes or skewed rules when setting up the machinery of our democracy. Transparency and mutual agreement are non-negotiable.

Kwa ufupi: Viongozi wa upinzani wamejitoa kwenye mazungumzo ya IEBC wakilalamikia utaratibu usio wa haki na ubaguzi. Tume ya uchaguzi lazima iwe huru na ya kuaminika kwa pande zote ili kulinda haki na amani ya nchi wetu.

Keep your eyes on the process. Stay informed, and stay engaged.
scripts.voice_note: Hapa ni Kenya on Record na ujumbe wa wiki hii. Opposition leaders have walked out of the ongoing IEBC talks, pointing out clear bias and flawed meeting procedures. Look, we need to pay close attention to this. The IEBC is the main referee for our elections. If the process of reforming or appointing the commission starts off with accusations of favoritism and procedural gatekeeping, it sets up the entire country for crisis down the line. Electoral integrity doesn't start on election day—it starts right now with how these negotiations are handled. Demand a fair, transparent referee for our democracy. Share this voice note with your network and let us keep track of every move.
